<title level="1" right="Rules">[Attack Rolls](/Rules.aspx?ID=219)</title>

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 278 <sup>4.0</sup>

<row gap="medium">
<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">
When making an attack roll, determine the result by rolling 1d20 and adding your attack modifier for the weapon or unarmed attack you’re using. Modifiers for melee and ranged attacks are calculated differently. 

<center>**Melee attack modifier = Strength modifier (or optionally Dexterity for a finesse weapon) + proficiency bonus + other bonuses + penalties**</center>

<center>**Ranged attack modifier = Dexterity modifier + proficiency bonus + other bonuses + penalties**</center> Bonuses, and penalties apply to these rolls just like with other types of checks. Weapons with [potency](/Equipment.aspx?ID=281) runes add an item bonus to your attack rolls.
</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>
